_comment: C-first B104 hero-to-monster H_WRAP recording. Wizard #polyself(POLY_CONTROLLED) selects giant eel, whose C monster table AT_TUCH/AD_WRAP slot exercises uhitm.c AD_WRAP dispatch. Three spaces after the form answer acknowledge the observed form-change, burden and dropped-quarterstaff More pages. #wizgenesis creates a sleeping hostile newt at the hero coordinate; the observed same-seed map placed it southeast, so F+n uses C force-fight without requiring movement while overloaded. The target is sleeping to make the source attack eligible; no slippery body armor is wished, so this exercises m_slips_free's no-protection return path if rn2(10) reaches it. The setup-position probe and its failed pager variants are kept privately under .cache/B104-logs.
